review.result: JDTLS project cleanup passes exact five-file edits, excluded-project preservation, compilation/runtime and repeat. Folder cleanup returns an empty client edit after presence of all six candidates is proven. Both JVMD commands are unsupported. All four shutdowns are clean.

Installed resourceFor constructs a file handle for a multi-segment project-relative path without a disk-type check. This is consistent with a folder URI reaching the file branch and returning no edit; the actual branch was not instrumented.
